criteria.contract: Add explicit optional authoring declaration of unmarried status for registered adults. Unknown historical or legacy marital status remains unknown; preserve imports, group copies, profile rebuild and old saved bytes without automatic rewriting.

Use the shared local adult family-consent rules for marriage and adoption: known representatives, actual presence, stable personal answer, separate house consent and explicit implementation. Preserve prior adoption behavior and original terms.

Reject existing/pending conflicting marriages and recorded adoptive ancestor/sibling marriage in either operation order. Proposal or consent is not yet a spouse relationship; marriage never changes other treaties, membership, office, land or money.

Connect the authoring declaration and local consultation/status/actions to the normal entry and runtime. Player decisions remain explicit; unknown or unavailable people are not presented as verified eligible.

Verify normal/refused/withdrawn/expired and house consent paths, both operation orders with adoption, real generation recovery/equal future, exact old saves and headless Godot positions. Merge tested code/docs and continue.

limits: 対象は開始時未婚と明示された成人登録武将の現地婚姻。史実の配偶者/血縁採録、出生、離縁、未成年予約、遠隔交渉、所属変更後の家再確認、婚姻後の相続資格は後続。性別・生殖のシミュレーションや史実家族関係を追加したものではない。既存の未設定登録や保存へ未婚・婚姻方式を自動追加しない。
